auth_files.priority_hint: Integers only. Invalid values are ignored. Larger value means higher priority.
auth_files.weight_hint: Defaults to 1. Values at or below 0 exclude this credential from weighted scheduling; maximum 1,000,000. After entering a value, enable <settingsLink>weighted round robin</settingsLink> for it to take effect.
auth_files.disable_cooling_hint: Skip failure cooldown and exponential backoff only for this credential; other credentials are unaffected.
auth_files.websockets_hint: Enable Responses API websocket transport for this credential.
auth_files.using_api_hint: Use the official xAI API when enabled; use Grok CLI chat-proxy when disabled.
auth_files.policy_alias_fork: Keep the original model in listings
auth_files.policy_alias_force_mapping: Rewrite response model to the alias
auth_files.policy_unsupported: Existing data cannot be edited with this form and will be preserved. Select Inherit to clear it, or replace it to start a new list.
auth_files.policy_retry_hint: Inherit uses the global request-retry setting. Custom 0 explicitly disables request retries for this credential.
auth_files.policy_aliases_hint: Account aliases are checked first; unmatched aliases fall back to channel aliases. Inherit or an empty list clears only account aliases.
auth_files.policy_rules_hint: Custom rules take precedence in list order. Inherit or an empty list uses inherited rules; it does not disable them. Regex patterns use Go syntax.
auth_files.policy_retry_invalid: Enter a non-negative safe integer, or select Inherit.
auth_files.policy_aliases_invalid: Enter a non-empty model name and alias for each new or edited row.
auth_files.policy_rules_invalid: Complete each edited rule with a positive status, an action and at least one non-empty match condition.
auth_files.note_placeholder: Enter a note, e.g.: John's account
auth_files.note_hint: Optional. Used to describe the purpose or owner of this credential; leave empty to omit.
auth_files.headers_hint: Enter custom HTTP headers as a JSON object, e.g., {"X-My-Header": "value"}
auth_files.headers_invalid_json: Custom headers must be valid JSON.
auth_files.headers_invalid_object: Custom headers must be a JSON object.
auth_files.headers_invalid_value: Each custom header value must be a string.
auth_files.prefix_proxy_invalid_json: This auth file is not a JSON object, so fields cannot be edited.
auth_files.prefix_proxy_html_challenge: Downloaded content is an HTML challenge page, not an auth JSON object. Re-authenticate or replace this auth file before editing fields.
auth_files.quota_refresh_hint: Refresh quota only for this credential
